title: BUAP Personalization Profile
description: Portable personalization profile for BUAP agents, Siri adapters, app intents, and chat surfaces.

user_display_name.description: Name or handle the assistant should use for the user.

buddy_display_name.description: User-selected visible name for the Buddy persona.

buddy_voice_style.description: Short label for the preferred visible tone/style.

buddy_personality_notes.description: Non-sensitive user-approved style notes for the Buddy persona.

first_run_personalization_complete.description: True only when both user_display_name and buddy_display_name are known.

last_confirmed_at.description: Date the personalization values were last confirmed, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
